item.title: Agent Runtime Architecture: How ADK Go Executes Agents
item.description: An in-depth look at ADK Go's Agent Runtime architecture — process model, goroutine-based concurrency, memory management, and how the Runtime interacts with Agents in production.

item.title: macOS 26 Window Corners Don't Match? No System Changes Needed—Here's the Fix
item.description: After upgrading to macOS 26, every app seems to have a different window corner radius. Disabling SIP and patching system files feels risky. There's a cleaner solution—Objective-C Runtime Hook—that keeps your system intact while making corners consistent across the board.

item.title: Go Memory Allocator: A Warehouse Manager's Tale
item.description: From 64MB warehouses to 8KB shelves, discover how Go's three-level cache architecture makes memory allocation blazing fast. Deep dive into arena, span, and size class design philosophy.
